source.description:
Followup from ext-src investigation (2026-07-25, ~/dev/xtrm branch xt/ext-src-invx read-only helper, report at /tmp/ext-src-report.md, also captured in ~/dev/xtrm bd memory 'ext-src-investigation-findings-report-at-tmp-ext').

## Findings summary

.xtrm/ext-src/ is vestigial pre-v0.7.8 dead code — DEPRECATED marker in docs/xtrm-directory.md:74,116,161, no writers in cli/src/, no readers at runtime. Consumer pi loads extensions via 'npm:@jaggerxtrm/pi-extensions' materialized into ~/.pi/agent/extensions/, not from .xtrm/ext-src/.

The pi-extension @xtrm/pi-service-skills is silently DORMANT on every consumer:
- Canonical (post-v0.7.8) resolveSkillScript targets .claude/skills/service-skills/scripts/ + .xtrm/skills/default/service-skills/scripts/ — neither exists on any consumer (~/.xtrm/skills/default/ has no service-skills nor service-knowledge dir)
- Both hook handlers return undefined when scripts not found → silent no-op
- Actual scripts live in the pipx service_knowledge python package; extension has zero code path to reach them

Rename impact = zero runtime effect (extension is no-op before AND after).

## Work items (release-train scope)

### 1. Prune .xtrm/ext-src/ on 9 consumer repos

Consumer copies enumerated at investigation time (2026-07-25):
- ~/projects/mercury/{barchart-scraper,darth-feedor,economic-data,infra,platform,quant,treasury-cb,website}
- ~/dev/transcriptoz

Approach options:
- Ship 'xt migrate ext-src' — proper migrator, idempotent rm-rf across .xtrm/ext-src/, one command per repo, could tail into 'xt update --apply'
- One-shot script (bash loop over the list above)
- Defer until each consumer naturally does xt update --apply which could also clean

NOT to include: ~/dev/core/.xtrm/ext-src/ (this repo's own ext-src) — core is authoritative, prune here decoupled from the migrator ship

### 2. Decide pi-extension @xtrm/pi-service-skills future

Two shapes (pick one):

**Retire** (zero consumer impact)
- Remove packages/pi-extensions/extensions/service-skills/
- Drop from packages/pi-extensions/src/manifest.json 'active' list
- Add to 'disabled' block with note (pattern: quality-gates, pi-serena-compact, gitnexus, serena)
- No follow-up migrator needed (consumers pick it up on xt pi setup)

**Rebuild** (revives the drift-injection + cataloger-injection UX on Pi sessions)
- Rename extensions/service-skills → extensions/service-knowledge
- Rename manifest.json id 'service-skills' → 'service-knowledge'
- Update MACHINERY_SKILL constant to 'service-knowledge' (dual-name array optional for one-release backward-compat)
- Add fallback in resolveSkillScript: when no on-disk script found, invoke 'python3 -m service_knowledge.scripts.<name>' (adjust the two SubprocessRunner.run() call sites to accept argv-array or resolve to that Python invocation)
- Ship in next @jaggerxtrm/pi-extensions release

## Coordinate with

- Jira epic ISSUE-51 (mercuryintel.atlassian.net/browse/ISSUE-51) — bootstrap-remaining-mercury-repos (8 P0 bd issues open, one per repo)
- xtrm-dev/infra bead infra-cwfj — duplicate/mirror of this bead scoped to infra's board
- Package: ~/dev/xtrm/packages/service-knowledge/ v0.7.0
- Recent shipped substrate: xtrm-dev/xtrm#21-#27, xtrm-dev/specialists#217, xtrm-dev/core#503

## Timing

Deferred until the current core sprint closes. No urgency: extension is dormant, ext-src is dead code, no user-facing pain today.
